global.description: Values injected by a parent chart when this chart is used as a subchart. Declared so that the strict additionalProperties check above does not reject Helm's own injection; nothing in this chart reads it.

vpcID.description: Zenlayer VPC ID. All subnets must belong to it.

subnetIDs.description: The only subnets pod addresses come from. The node's primary interface serves pods only when its subnet is listed. At most 5.

secretName.description: Secret holding AccessKeyID / AccessKeyPassword. Created out of band, never templated.

dataPath.description: veth pair + per-ENI policy routing. The only supported datapath. Any other value is refused here at install time, and by the CNI plugin on every ADD; the daemon does not read this field.

ipStack.description: Address families given to pods. "dual" requires every subnet in zec.subnetIDs to carry both an IPv4 and an IPv6 CIDR; the daemon refuses to start otherwise rather than quietly serving only one family. IPv6-only is refused here: it is not implemented (capacity reporting, the IPv4 service-CIDR requirement, and the IPv4 address every new interface comes with).

ipv6InternetChargeType.description: How the platform bills public IPv6 on an interface, used only when ipStack is "dual". The platform refuses to enable IPv6 on an interface without this when the subnet's ipv6Type is Public, which every dual-stack subnet seen so far is -- and since the daemon enables IPv6 on each interface it creates, this setting decides what the cluster is billed for. Ignored on a Private-IPv6 subnet. ByTrafficPackage also needs ipv6PackageSize; BandwidthCluster also needs ipv6ClusterId.

ipv6Bandwidth.description: Public IPv6 cap in Mbps per interface, shared by every pod on that interface; used only when ipStack is "dual".

ipv6PackageSize.description: Traffic package size in TB, required by the platform when ipv6InternetChargeType is "ByTrafficPackage". 0 means unset; ByTrafficPackage needs a positive multiple of 0.1. A fraction passed with --set arrives as a string and is refused here; use --set-json.

ipv6ClusterId.description: Shared bandwidth package to join, required by the platform when ipv6InternetChargeType is "BandwidthCluster".

serviceCidr.description: Service CIDR(s), comma-separated. Empty means the daemon reads it from kube-system/kubeadm-config, which only works on kubeadm clusters -- set it explicitly elsewhere or the daemon will not start. Nothing in the datapath acts on it: service traffic already traverses the host stack.

logLevel.description: Empty keeps the built-in default (info). Drives ZENLAYER_CNI_LOGLEVEL on the DaemonSet and, for debug, the conflist debug flag zec-cni reads.

manageUntaggedENI.description: Adopt secondary interfaces attached to the node that this plugin did not create and that carry no zenlayer:cni:no-manage tag. Required, no default, so a later chart cannot flip it on upgrade. false leaves such interfaces alone, though they still consume the instance's interface quota.

ipamType.description: Who calls the Zenlayer OpenAPI: direct (every node, with credentials) or crd (only the controlplane; nodes hold none). Required, no default.

mode.description: Which plugin owns the pod device. "chained": this plugin creates it and Cilium is chained after. "delegated": Cilium creates it and this plugin only does IPAM plus host routing; requires cilium.enabled=true.

enabled.description: Chain cilium-cni after this plugin (generic-veth chaining). Does not install Cilium; deploy it from its own chart -- see docs/deploy-cilium-chained.md.

waitTimeout.description: How long the daemon waits for the cilium agent socket before restarting. Go duration syntax; empty, or a value that does not parse or is not positive (logged), keeps the 5m default.

enabled.description: Declares that NetworkPolicy must be enforced; on requires the provider to be enabled -- with cilium, cilium.enabled=true -- or the chart refuses to render. Off declares nothing: with cilium.enabled the Cilium agent still enforces policy.

provider.description: Engine expected to enforce policy. Only cilium.
